title: AC-2/AC-3 verification methodology was broken — deleting only target/release/codex-core.exe doesn't exercise sccache
resolution: Replaced AC-2/AC-3 with operator-driven OV-1/OV-2 using fresh-CARGO_TARGET_DIR-per-scenario protocol. Required ACs now focus on script existence + correct content (AC-1, AC-2 for parse-only smoke), with wall-time measurement deferred to follow-up task codex-rs-build-perf-baseline-measurement.

title: US-3 benchmark requires operator-driven multi-hour builds + admin perms; impl member cannot satisfy autonomously
resolution: Split US-3 into US-3a (autonomous tooling + methodology doc, ships with this PR) and US-3b (recorded numbers, filed as new tracked task codex-rs-build-perf-baseline-measurement).

title: Cargo invocations used `--bin codex-core` without `-p codex-cli`; codex-core is a binary of the codex-cli package, NOT a -p codex-core build
resolution: All cargo commands in plan, stories-outline, iteration-env.sh, and measure-build.ps1 now use `cargo build --release -p codex-cli --bin codex-core`. Documented as a Risk Area item with cross-link to codex/CLAUDE.md confusion-point.

title: AC-8 only checked committed diff (origin/main..HEAD), missing staged and working-tree Rust changes
resolution: Replaced single AC-8 grep with new AC-7 set of four checks: committed diff, staged diff, working-tree diff, plus submodule status. All four must return empty.

title: Codex submodule gitlink update missing — wrapper edits to codex/ must trigger a codexu-side gitlink bump
resolution: Added new AC-11 verifying a separate `chore(codex): bump submodule for iteration-env + sccache wire-up` commit in codexu after the codex-side push. Documented as a 'Two pushes required' note in the Next Step section and in Files to Modify table.

title: sccache server-state ambiguity — exporting SCCACHE_DIR doesn't move an already-running server
resolution: iteration-env.sh now runs `sccache --show-stats` to read active location and runs `sccache --stop-server` + `sccache --start-server` if mismatched against D:\codex-sccache. Added as Risk Area #7 and acceptance criterion AC-1.

title: Missing SCCACHE_CACHE_SIZE — default 10GB may evict during matrix testing
resolution: iteration-env.sh now exports SCCACHE_CACHE_SIZE=50G. Added as Risk Area #8.

title: iteration-env.sh path resolution undefined — could fail if sourced from wrong cwd
resolution: Script uses SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd) for path independence. Documented in Files to Create + stories-outline US-1.

title: `cargo check --workspace` recommended after every story is overkill for docs-only stories
resolution: Replaced per-story `cargo check --workspace` with cheaper `cargo metadata --no-deps` workspace-parse check (AC-8), plus per-story script syntax checks. Full cargo check is no longer required since this plan changes no Rust source.

title: Defender exclusion guidance lacks elevation note; could be misinterpreted as blocking
resolution: Defender exclusion is now explicitly marked OPTIONAL and runnable-from-elevated-PowerShell-only in Preconditions; impl member does NOT block on failure. Risk Area #4 updated.

title: Committing exact cold/warm benchmark numbers in build-perf.md creates stale machine-specific docs
resolution: build-perf.md §3 Recorded Measurements has only column headers + `<!-- TODO operator-driven -->` placeholder; actual CSV output goes to gitignored docs/implementation/build-perf-artifacts/ dir. Operator can choose to commit a specific reference run by moving the CSV in manually.

title: Original ACs mixed 'verifiable' with 'not hard fail thresholds' — ambiguous for Ralph autonomous mode
resolution: ACs now split into Required (autonomously verifiable, hard pass/fail) and Operator-validation (deferred to follow-up task). No 'soft' ACs remain in the Required set.

title: Frozen-profile drift enforcement (sentinel/hash check) is weak — relies on docs + script alone
resolution: Acknowledged in Risk Area #1. Adding a machine-checkable sentinel adds significant complexity (sentinel format, hash computation, wrapper for cargo invocations) for marginal gain — the explicit confusion-point in CLAUDE.md plus the FROZEN PROFILE ACTIVE banner from iteration-env.sh should be sufficient for the small team using this dev box. If r6 pattern recurs after ship, file a follow-up to add sentinel enforcement.
